overall_notes: The paper focuses on query-efficient black-box red teaming using Bayesian optimization to identify offensive outputs from generative models. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and consolidation of redundant information. The paper evaluates multiple NLG tasks and uses both automatic metrics (RSR, Self-BLEU) and human evaluation (Amazon Mechanical Turk) for assessment.
